notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded Publish Object Class Attributes implementation to the exact official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador declaration exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies the signature, declared exception set, adapter symbol, and real Catch2 selectors. The baseline declaration case verifies lifecycle/FOM-handle boundaries; the focused filesystem-report case verifies that an undefined class appends nothing and an accepted publication appends one successful-void record with ObjectClassHandle type 36 and AttributeHandleSet type 1. Advisory and ownership-assumption delivery matrices, MOM interaction delivery, timestamped behavior, save/restore, DDM, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, validation, and conformance remain outside this slice.
